reading.title: Should volunteering be compulsory?
reading.text: Several countries now make community service compulsory for secondary students. In my view, this is a mistake. Young people who are compelled to help others often do the minimum, and some schools even threaten to expel pupils who fail to complete their hours. Real volunteering is driven by an inner impulse, not by a rule. That said, I accept that a short, well-designed programme can propel shy teenagers into experiences they would never try alone. The challenge is to invite them without repelling them.

items.s: Compulsory community service is a good idea.
Students who are forced to volunteer tend to make little effort.
